answer: A sybil cluster shows up as a ripple of identical timing signatures across fresh keys, so peers weight votes by stake age and slash any key whose knoll diverges from its ripple history, making mass reputation slot creation costlier than honest participation. Each agent must stake a unique onyx token bound to a verified hardware root, and every epoch it publishes a signed knoll of prior attestations. In practice, sa0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
